title: Subset
summary: A is a subset of B when every member of A is also a member of B.

context.note: This node belongs to one explicit foundational presentation; alternate foundations may encode it differently.

assumptions.text: The declared set-like mathematics context is fixed.

content.plain: A is a subset of B when every member of A is also a member of B.
content.example: The even integers form a subset of the integers.
content.caveat: Subset inclusion is a relation between sets; membership relates an element to a set.
